ios.note: Apple blocks Stremio from the App Store, so on iPhone/iPad you run Stremio in Safari and play through VLC. A debrid key makes this much smoother (streams become direct links Safari can play on its own).
steps: Install VLC (free) from the App Store.
In Safari, open web.stremio.com and log in with the email & password above.
Tap Share → ‘Add to Home Screen’ so it opens like a real app.
In Stremio Web, open Settings and turn on ‘Play in external player’.
Pick a title and tap a stream — when prompted, open it in VLC. (Direct & debrid links also play in Safari itself.)

_notes.schema: Add-ons are defined once under `addons` and referenced by id from `packs`, `baseline`, and the toggles. The frontend fetches this file and builds the Stremio addon collection in-browser.
_notes.manifest_vs_assemble: Most add-ons carry a static `manifest`. Torrentio instead carries `assemble` (base + providers + quality_modes); the frontend builds its URL and appends the chosen debrid param/key when supplied.
_notes.needs_url: needs_url:true means NO single shareable manifest (config-encoded or per-user key). These never auto-apply — they render as 'Configure & install' link-outs using `configure_url`.
_notes.protected: Cinemeta, OpenSubtitles v3 and Local Files are Stremio defaults flagged protected. addonCollectionSet REPLACES the whole collection, so the frontend preserves protected defaults and only prunes the ones listed under `defaults`.
_notes.always_on: Torrentio carries always_on:true — distinct from protected (it's OUR baseline guarantee, not a Stremio-official default). It's already in `baseline` so every normal (non-legal-mode, non-exclusive-pack) resolution includes it regardless of pack/Custom picks; always_on additionally hides it from the Custom picker so the UI can't show a checkbox that looks toggleable but silently has no effect. Legal Mode still strips it (that's the toggle's entire purpose) and exclusive packs (Kids) still replace the baseline outright — always_on does not override either.

defaults._note: Stremio seeds new accounts with these official addons. addonCollectionSet replaces the whole collection, so the frontend drops these transportUrls from the fetched defaults before appending the user's picks. Protected defaults (Cinemeta, Local Files) are always kept.

_packs_model: Packs are ADDITIVE — tapping several merges their addon sets on top of the baseline. 'Custom' exposes every addon as an individual toggle, pre-checked from the chosen packs. 'Everything' = select all non-adult, non-exclusive packs. Adult is its own age-gated pack. A pack with exclusive:true (Kids) cannot combine with anything: selecting it clears + locks all other packs, toggles, debrid and Custom, and its addon set REPLACES the baseline (no Torrentio).

modes.balanced: Balanced — a good mix of quality and availability. Best for most people.
modes.quality: Quality — fewer results, highest quality first (bigger files).
modes.quantity: Quantity — the most results, ordered by seeders (most likely to start fast).

max_quality.label: Max quality
max_quality.blurb: Cap the top resolution — handy for slow connections, mobile data, or older TVs.

debrid.label: Debrid key (optional)
debrid.blurb: Paste a Real-Debrid / AllDebrid / Premiumize key for instant, buffer-free cached streams. Leave blank for free public torrents.

toggles._omitted_filters: Codec filtering (HEVC/x265), reliable audio-language priority, and custom private trackers are NOT possible via Torrentio's shareable URL. Users who need those should pick AIOStreams in Advanced — it filters by codec, language, resolution, size, seeders and more (debrid required).

email_gen._note: Dice button on the email step. Stremio never sends a confirmation email, so a disposable address works fine. Pattern: {word}-{4 lowercase a-z}@{domain}. The word is picked at random from `words`.
